provenance: Observations of the lock-pinned Loki 3.5.2 oracle (image sha256:fb2284f9e54e7681eab601ffa73b3e0af7ae9f57aad9a5222b49da6ff56cc572, commit 257d2f62bf8a81b44dea6fe88968d1d28c8e01e7) via the harness logql-metric phase (querycheck compare --phase logql-metric --require-locked, Windows docker client against the local daemon) on rate_counter probes the first 227 recorded rows did not cover: windows 1s..1h incl. non-integer (1500ms, 2500ms, 250ms, 100ms), spacings 1ms..30s, the 1.1*spacing half-spacing threshold and the zero-intercept cap swept across both boundaries, multiplicity at threshold crossings, negative values, multi-reset, non-finite values, empty/single-sample/edge windows, offsets, two streams, range queries, exact toStart==1.1*spacing equality (window 11s/22s/... with 10us/20us/... spacing) and compound duration literals (1m1s, 1h1m, 1h30m, 2m3s4ms); the oracle rejects `us` and `ns` as duration units, so the window's millisecond floor is unobservable. Each probe was run twice; all reference outputs were identical between runs. Not authored predictions.
